bayts.text: Your Lord suffices you: He will suffice you against an overflowing (calamity), whose overflowing is like a hidden ambush from a king.
Your Lord suffices you, Guarantor and refuge of every great one, against a star that imitated the star of the celestial sphere,

(a calamity) returning, onslaught after onslaught, like the onslaught that returns deep in the liver; it mocks you by sowing doubt: (He suffices you) against the menacing breast of every hostile force, against all.
